modernopt.screen.title: ModernOPT Settings
modernopt.screen.subtitle: RENDER CONTROL • PERFORMANCE MONITOR
modernopt.option.enabled.desc: Master switch for render scaling, upscaling and anti-aliasing. Impact: LOW when off; changes world rendering when on.
modernopt.option.scale.desc: Internal world resolution as a percentage of window size. Lower values can greatly reduce GPU pixel work but soften detail. Impact: HIGH potential GPU benefit at low scales; visual quality decreases.
modernopt.option.upscaler.desc: FSR 1: edge-aware reconstruction, MEDIUM GPU cost. Bilinear: simple and LOW cost. Nearest: LOW cost but pixelated. SoftScale: LOW-to-MEDIUM cost. None skips the post-process shader.
modernopt.option.fsr1Fp16.desc: Use native half-precision EASU/RCAS when supported. Turn off to A/B test the FP32 path; FP16 is not guaranteed to be faster on every GPU.
modernopt.screen.fsr1_fp16.tip: Enables native half-precision EASU/RCAS where supported. Turn off to compare FP32 performance on the same scene.
modernopt.option.dynamic.desc: Automatically adjusts world resolution toward target FPS. Impact: MEDIUM complexity; may help GPU-bound frame pacing but image sharpness can change dynamically.
modernopt.option.targetfps.desc: Target frame rate from 30 to 540 FPS. Sets the dynamic resolution controller goal; not a frame-rate limiter. Impact: LOW.
modernopt.option.minScale.desc: Lowest allowed world render scale. Lower values may improve GPU-bound performance but reduce image detail. Impact: HIGH potential GPU benefit, lower quality.
modernopt.option.maxScale.desc: Highest allowed world render scale. Higher values improve detail but increase GPU pixel work. Impact: MEDIUM-to-HIGH depending on resolution.
modernopt.option.ssaa.desc: Render at 2x width and height then downsample. Impact: VERY HIGH GPU and memory cost (about four times the world pixels). Mutually exclusive with FXAA and MSAA.
modernopt.option.fxaa.desc: Fast post-process anti-aliasing. Impact: LOW GPU cost; may soften fine detail. Mutually exclusive with SSAA and MSAA.
modernopt.option.msaa.desc: Multisample anti-aliasing at 2x, 4x, 8x, or 16x. Impact: MEDIUM-to-VERY HIGH GPU/memory cost as samples increase. Mutually exclusive with FXAA and SSAA.
modernopt.benchmark.title: ModernOPT Benchmark
modernopt.benchmark.requirements: Benchmark requires a local single-player world and Spectator mode.
modernopt.profile.title: Render profile
modernopt.profile.desc: Choose a paired world-scale and upscaler preset. Quality: 75% + FSR1; Balanced: 60% + FSR1; Performance: 50% + Bilinear; Ultra Performance: 35% + direct blit. Lower presets may improve GPU-bound FPS but reduce detail. Custom preserves manual values.
modernopt.option.irisShadowScale.desc: Experimental. Reduces Iris shader-pack shadow-map resolution; disabled by default for compatibility.
modernopt.option.irisShadowResolution.de: Set the fixed Iris shadow-map resolution in pixels (512–8192). Enable shadow-map scaling and reload the shader pack.
modernopt.option.shadowFrameSkip.desc: Temporarily bypassed for safety. Enabling this option does not skip shadow updates until ModernOPT can cache and restore both the shadow map and matching matrices without breaking Iris state.
modernopt.option.shadowUpdateFps.desc: Target shadow refresh rate from 40 to 240 FPS. If the game runs below the target, shadows update every frame.
modernopt.page.render.tip: World resolution, upscaling and anti-aliasing controls.
modernopt.page.overlay.tip: Customize the on-screen performance display and TXT sampling log.
modernopt.page.particles.tip: Optional visual-only distance culling. Particle simulation is unchanged.
modernopt.screen.master.tip: Master switch for ModernOPT world rendering. Low overhead when disabled; restart the world if a render target looks incorrect.
modernopt.screen.preset.tip: Cycles Native → Quality → Balanced → Performance → Ultra Performance. Changes both world scale and upscaler. Lower resolution can improve GPU-bound performance but reduces detail.
modernopt.screen.scale.tip: Internal world resolution as a percentage of window size. Lower values reduce pixel work (potentially high GPU benefit) but make the world softer. HUD stays native resolution.
modernopt.screen.upscaler.tip: Cycles None, FSR 1, Bilinear, Nearest and SoftScale. FSR 1 gives edge-aware reconstruction (medium GPU cost); Bilinear is simple (low); Nearest is sharp/pixelated (low); SoftScale is a soft reconstruction (low-to-medium).
modernopt.screen.dynamic.tip: Adjusts world scale toward a target FPS. Can stabilize GPU-bound frame times; image sharpness may change while moving. Medium complexity.
modernopt.screen.fxaa.tip: Fast post-process anti-aliasing. Low performance cost; may soften fine details. May be bypassed with shader packs.
modernopt.screen.ssaa.tip: Render at 2× width and height then downsample. Very high GPU/memory cost (about 4× world pixels); use only with performance headroom.
modernopt.screen.msaa.tip: Cycles Off, 2×, 4×, 8× and 16×. GPU and memory cost rises with sample count; high values can be very expensive and may be unavailable on some hardware.
modernopt.screen.overlay.tip: Show FPS, frame time, memory and current render settings. Negligible-to-low CPU cost.
modernopt.screen.logging.tip: Append a sample to config/modernopt-performance.txt at the chosen interval. Low disk overhead; disable when finished collecting data.
modernopt.screen.log_interval.tip: How often to append one line to the TXT log. Longer intervals reduce disk activity.
modernopt.screen.show_fps.tip: Displays Minecraft's current FPS counter. Negligible cost.
modernopt.screen.show_frame.tip: Displays approximate CPU-side interval between HUD renders in milliseconds; not a GPU timer. Negligible cost.
modernopt.screen.show_memory.tip: Shows used, allocated and maximum Java heap memory. This is not GPU VRAM usage. Negligible cost.
modernopt.screen.show_render.tip: Shows render scale, upscaler and particle culling distance. Negligible cost.
modernopt.screen.position.tip: Cycles top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right.
modernopt.screen.particle_culling.tip: Skip drawing particles beyond the selected distance; particles still tick and expire normally. Low-to-medium GPU benefit in particle-heavy scenes; adds a small per-particle distance check. Disabled by default.
modernopt.screen.particle_distance.tip: Maximum distance in blocks at which particles are drawn. Lower values hide distant effects sooner; does not alter particle simulation.
modernopt.screen.show_cpu.tip: Shows approximate Java-process and whole-system CPU load when the Java runtime exposes it. It may show n/a on unsupported runtimes. Low overhead; this is not GPU utilization.
modernopt.page.dynamic.tip: Dynamic resolution and Iris shadow controls. Iris features are experimental.
modernopt.screen.target_fps.tip: Target for dynamic resolution, not an FPS cap. Impact: LOW; a realistic target helps reduce GPU-bound frame-time spikes.
modernopt.screen.min_scale.tip: Lowest world resolution dynamic scaling may select. Lower values can improve GPU-bound performance but reduce detail. Impact: HIGH potential GPU benefit at the cost of image quality.
modernopt.screen.max_scale.tip: Highest world resolution dynamic scaling may select. Higher values preserve detail but increase GPU work. Impact: MEDIUM to HIGH.
modernopt.screen.iris_shadow_scale.tip: Experimental Iris integration. Can reduce shadow-map cost but may affect shader-pack visuals or compatibility. Impact: MEDIUM to HIGH; off by default.
Selects the fixed shadow-map resolution. Lower values reduce memory/GPU work but soften shadows. Impact: MEDIUM to HIGH; takes effect according to the shader-pack integration.
modernopt.screen.shadow_skip.tip: Experimental: caches the last complete Iris shadow pass and its camera matrices between refreshes. Moving shadow casters can lag; disabled by default.
modernopt.screen.shadow_fps.tip: Maximum shadow refresh rate when shadow caching is enabled. If the game runs below this rate, shadows refresh every rendered frame.
modernopt.screen.profiling.tip: Writes periodic CPU-side render timing and target dimensions to latest.log. Does not measure GPU execution time. Impact: LOW; turn off after collecting a sample.
modernopt.page.benchmark.tip: Record per-frame timing and export a CSV report.
modernopt.screen.show_one_percent_low.ti: Estimates 1% low FPS from the slowest 1% of recent frame intervals. CPU-side estimate, not a GPU timer.
modernopt.screen.show_p95.tip: Shows the 95th percentile of recent HUD frame intervals to expose stutter spikes.
modernopt.screen.opacity.tip: Adjust the on-screen statistics background opacity from transparent to opaque.
modernopt.screen.benchmark_recording.tip: Start or stop recording one row per rendered HUD frame to config/modernopt-benchmarks/benchmark-*.csv. This records client frame intervals, not GPU execution time.
modernopt.screen.benchmark_status.tip: Shows whether a capture is active and the summary from the last finished capture.
modernopt.screen.diag_sample_interval.ti: Write one CSV row every Nth frame to reduce overhead at the cost of fewer samples.
modernopt.screen.benchmark_duration.tip: Automatically stop CSV capture after this duration; 0 means stop manually.
modernopt.screen.benchmark_cpu.tip: Include process and system CPU load in CSV; disable to reduce measured overhead.
modernopt.screen.benchmark_memory.tip: Include Java heap usage in CSV; disable to omit these measurements.
modernopt.advisor.memory: Advice: Java heap is near its limit; check memory pressure and GC pauses before changing render settings.
modernopt.advisor.world_cpu: Advice: world-pass CPU time is high; try lower simulation/render distance or reduce entity-heavy workloads. Lower render scale may not help a CPU-bound scene.
modernopt.advisor.post_cpu: Advice: ModernOPT post-processing CPU time is noticeable; try Bilinear or None and compare with FXAA off. These are CPU timings, not GPU timings.
modernopt.advisor.shaderpack: Advice: a shader pack is active; these timings do not measure GPU execution. Compare the same scene with the pack disabled before attributing the slowdown.
modernopt.advisor.cpu_load: Advice: CPU load is high; check background tasks and reduce CPU-heavy world/entity settings before lowering render scale.
modernopt.advisor.compare_scale: Advice: no clear CPU bottleneck was detected. Compare 100% and 50% render scale in the same scene; pixel reduction helps mainly when GPU-bound.
modernopt.advisor.healthy: Advice: no obvious CPU-side bottleneck detected in these samples. Compare frame-time p95 across identical test runs.
